props.name: action
props.description:
The action to be performed by the button.
Must be one of the following values: "delete" or "modify".

props.name: icon
props.description: Determines if an icon should be displayed on the button.

props.name: item
props.description: The item that the action will be performed on.

props.name: label
props.description:
Determines if the button should display a label.
If false, the button will use a visually hidden text for accessibility.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Slot used to provide custom content for the button text.
